name: Avalara
tagline: Avalara is a cloud-based tax compliance platform that automates sales tax, VAT, GST, and customs duty calculations across hundreds of countries and thousands of tax jurisdictions. Finance and e-commerce teams use it to ensure accurate tax rates are applied at checkout and to automate multi-jurisdiction tax filing, replacing manual spreadsheet processes that break as businesses expand into new markets. It integrates with ERP systems, e-commerce platforms, and billing tools through a broad partner ecosystem.
